content.comment_body: I'm using [product_name] version [version_no] and a [product_name] PLC. I have several softkeys in my program, set to default 'on', but when I download the program to the PLC, the softkeys appear 'off'. Has [company_name] prevented parameters from defaulting to 'on'?
This is a documented issue in either the PLC or the programming software.
Hello, what type of signal is connected before the software keys?
I've connected the softkey blocks directly to the high rails. I ended up inverting my logic, which works as a workaround. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a problem where setting softkey defaults to 'on' in the software did not result in the expected 'on' state on the PLC after transferring the program. Another user confirmed this is a known issue, and the original user resolved it by adjusting their logic as a workaround.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that softkey default configurations set in the programming software will be accurately transferred and reflected on the PLC, without unexpected changes or bugs.
